coverIntro: Van Dijk Techniek's eight sales representatives maintain separate pipeline sheets. Marloes spends four hours merging them, yet Monday's overview is already outdated. How can management start the week with a current pipeline? Datavance connects the existing SharePoint sheets to one automatically refreshed Power BI dashboard. The dashboard keeps the representatives' working method intact while bringing stages, expected revenue and progress against target together. Management can compare regions and representatives, see missing information and use one consistent overview in the Monday 9:00 meeting.
situation: Separate Excel sheets make pipeline status, stalled deals and progress against target unreliable. The sheets live in SharePoint and vary in structure and completeness. Exact Online handles accounting; there is no CRM functionality in use.
goals: Start Monday with a current pipeline
approach: This is not a CRM project. We standardise the existing SharePoint sheets and show stages, expected revenue and progress against target in Power BI. Representatives keep their existing Excel workflow. We normalise column names and stage definitions, flag incomplete sheets and missing closing dates, and retain those deals as open items. The overview breaks results down by representative and region and refreshes before the Monday 9:00 management meeting.
scopeDeliverables: SharePoint and Excel connection. Reads the eight representatives' existing files automatically from their shared folder.
Consistent pipeline data model. Aligns columns, stage definitions and expected closing dates without silently dropping incomplete deals.
Dashboard with weekly refresh and data flags. Shows expected revenue and progress against the 4.8 million target, by representative and region.

phases.name: Week 1
phases.description: Connect sheets and align pipeline stages. Agree the column structure, normalisation rules and definitions used by the representatives.

phases.name: Weeks 2–4
phases.description: Build, test and deliver the dashboard. Run a full weekly cycle with real sheets and adjust the dashboard with Marloes before handover.

investment: One fixed price for this scoped problem, confirmed after the scoping call. The call confirms sheet structure, source access and the desired breakdown before work starts.
nextSteps: Approve the proposal, then align the pipeline stages in a 30-minute call with Marloes. Review source access and definitions together so the weekly overview uses one consistent set of stages before the first refresh.
